# Synthetic fixtures

Everything in this folder is made up. Nothing was read from a real phone. The model name is
`SYNTHETIC-IQOO15`, the serial numbers are `SYNTHETIC-SERIAL-0000` and `SYNTHETICSERIAL01`/`02`, and the feed
logs were generated by a script. They exist so the parsers and the bench logic can be tested without a phone.

- `getprop.txt`: a full-looking `getprop` dump, including keys that must be dropped (serials, timezone).
- `getprop-filtered.txt`, `meminfo.txt`, `wm-size.txt`, `wm-density.txt`, `dumpsys-display-modes.txt`: the raw
  files `workshop.bench.device_profile` saves and reads back (`--from-dir` uses these names).
  `getprop-filtered.txt` is exactly what `filter_props` keeps from `getprop.txt` (a test checks this).
- `captured-at.txt`: the fixed capture time used by `--from-dir`.
- `devices-*.txt`: `adb devices` output with no device, one device, an unauthorized device and two devices.
- `activities.txt`: two lines of `dumpsys activity activities`.
- `logcat-hello.txt`: two `VEIL_HELLO` lines (the parser must take the last one).
- `feedlog-ok.jsonl`: a Test Feed log of a feed that scrolled; `feedlog-noscroll.jsonl`: one that did not.
